meta.description:
A two-storey witch's cottage built around an earthy herbal kitchen and a secluded candlelit attic study. A compact stair hall rises from the kitchen wing into the study above,
    while a small entry and herb pantry give the ground floor a practical, lived-in character.

layout.description:
A two-storey witch's cottage built around an earthy herbal kitchen and a secluded candlelit attic study. A compact stair hall rises from the kitchen wing into the study above,
    while a small entry and herb pantry give the ground floor a practical, lived-in character.

rooms.name: The Hearthroot Kitchen
rooms.style: A warm herbal kitchen with broad worktables, rounded hearth forms, hanging bundles of plants, ceramic vessels, and dark timber-like superquadric furnishings.

rooms.name: The Greenleaf Pantry
rooms.style: A narrow pantry lined with shelves of dried herbs, seed jars, roots, and apothecary containers, using mossy stone colors and stacked organic forms.

rooms.name: The Mooncap Entry
rooms.style: A low welcoming entry with a crooked bench, peg forms, woven-looking rounded objects, and a small display of moonlit mushrooms and protective charms.

rooms.name: The Crooked Stair Hall
rooms.style: A tight vertical hall containing a narrow winding stair, with dark polished rails, wall niches, and small geometric charms embedded in the plaster.
